title: Locate multiple target objects before transporting them
description: Use when a task requires moving multiple instances of the same object type to a destination.
content: When the task asks for multiple objects of the same type, first search likely surfaces such as tables and open containers to find all instances before starting to move them. In this case, both watches were found together on the dining table, so checking a single surface thoroughly can reveal all needed items at once.

title: Transport items one at a time to the destination
description: Use when moving multiple objects to the same target location.
content: Pick up one object, navigate to the destination, and place it there before returning for the next object. This avoids carrying capacity issues and keeps the destination state clear after each placement.

title: Verify destination contents after each placement
description: Use when placing multiple items at a destination to confirm progress.
content: After moving an item to the destination, observe the destination to confirm the item is present before fetching the next one. This helps track how many items have been successfully placed and prevents redundant trips.

title: Search systematically for target objects in storage furniture
description: Use when a required object is not immediately visible and must be located in closed storage.
content: When searching for an object, systematically go to and open each cabinet, drawer, or shelf in the area rather than assuming its location. Check the contents of each opened container before moving on, and continue until the target object is found.
